additions.actor: Authorized backoffice operator or trusted ViStay service

inScope: Add V6 reconciliation observation/difference/decision/manual-case/repair-result tables for mapping, ARI watermark and booking revision domains.

interfaces: Expose only the operations named in this issue through the owning GraphQL or gRPC boundary.

Booking owns reservations, exact-unit inventory and immutable price snapshots; Property owns exact-unit identity; secrets remain in the configured secret store.
stateMachine: Run is REQUESTED -> RUNNING -> CONSISTENT/DRIFT_FOUND/PARTIAL/FAILED.
Case is OPEN -> AUTO_REPAIRING/IN_REVIEW -> RESOLVED/WAIVED/FAILED_REPAIR; semantic conflict cannot auto-resolve.
Repair is PROPOSED -> AUTHORIZED -> EXECUTED -> VERIFIED/FAILED and retains before/after fingerprints.

dataPartitions: ADMIN organization plus the exact SITE/BRANCH/property mapping partition; SYSTEM only for authenticated Booking, Property, scheduler, webhook and repair calls.
fieldGroups: OTA_SUMMARY is baseline; MAPPING, FINANCIAL, PII, PROVIDER_DETAIL, EXTERNAL_PAYLOAD and INTERNAL_AUDIT require explicit grants.

failureSemantics: Reject unrecognized provider/property/mapping/revision, forbidden partition/field group, malformed payload and missing dependency before an external or local state change.
Classify 429 and transport/5xx as bounded transient failures; classify authentication, mapping, schema and per-value ARI warnings as visible non-success requiring correction or reconciliation.
Never silently cancel, remap or overwrite a ViStay reservation during a conflict; move it to NEEDS_MANUAL_RESOLUTION with redacted evidence.
idempotencyConcurrency: Require an idempotency key for commands that can be retried externally and persist its request fingerprint and result.
Use aggregate version compare-and-swap so concurrent writers produce one winner and a stable conflict for losers.
Deduplicate consumed events by event ID and business key.
